investigator: fresh oracle subagent (no access to src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, diff, or git history)

evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

method_note: The scenario's input tuple (champions, levels, ranks, target resistances) is defined outside my permitted evidence tree, so the leaf cannot be reconstructed as an absolute number from data/ alone. What IS decidable from data/ is the multiplier between the two candidate values: a golden leaf rounded to 1 dp pins the true ratio to a narrow interval, and that interval admits exactly one wiki-sourced constant.

step_1_observed_ratio.note: Underlying unrounded pair must satisfy x in [94.121, 94.149] for x and 1.08*x to display as 94.1 and 101.7 — a non-empty, self-consistent band.

step_2_candidate_multipliers_from_cached.candidate: Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness' applied to the partner's damage (melee holder, 8%)
Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness' at the ranged value (5%)
Black Cleaver average-stack model change: constant 0.8*C = 4 stacks (24% shred) -> Cesaro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h) -> 5 stacks (30% shred), per docs/math-foundations.md 2.3(2)
step_2_candidate_multipliers_from_cached.verdict: excluded — no reachable Summoner's Rift armor produces a +8.08% swing from a 24%->30% shred change

step_2_candidate_multipliers_from_cached.candidate: Black Cleaver 'Carve' shred becoming visible to the partner's damage at all (0% -> 30% shred on the shared target)
step_2_candidate_multipliers_from_cached.in_interval: yes, but only for a fitted target armor of ~32-34
step_2_candidate_multipliers_from_cached.verdict: same-direction alternative — requires one fitted parameter; does not change the verdict (see reconciliation)

independent_computation.step_3_conclusion: The only parameter-free, armor-independent multiplier in the cached wiki corpus that reproduces 94.1 -> 101.7 is exactly 1.08 — Bloodsong's 'Expose Weakness', melee value. Independent recomputation of the leaf: 94.1(4) x 1.08 = 101.7 (1 dp). The old value 94.1 corresponds to that debuff (or the equivalent shared target-side shred) being credited only to its own holder and NOT to the partner's damage inside the coupled pair fight — which contradicts the item's own wording, 'take 8% increased damage from all sources'.
independent_computation.step_4_direction_check: Both surviving readings (Bloodsong 'from all sources', or Black Cleaver's armor shred as a state on the shared target) are the same class of defect and point the same way: a target-side debuff that every source should see was being withheld from the coupled partner. Under either reading the correction raises pair_damage, and 101.7 is the corrected figure. There is no reading under which 94.1 is the corrected figure.

sources_quoted.quote: the established model uses a fixed `0.8*max_stacks` constant (with a `hits/2` short-fight branch) ... the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp `min(k, C)` over `h` hits is `C - C(C-1)/(2h)` for `h >= C`
sources_quoted.load_bearing: defines the competing BC hypothesis (24% -> up to 30% shred), which the armor sweep excludes

sources_quoted.quote: R_final = max(0, (R - r_flat)*(1 - r_pct/100)*(1 - p) - f)
sources_quoted.load_bearing: confirms percentage armor reduction multiplies the running armor, giving the (100+0.76R)/(100+0.70R) form used above

residual_uncertainty: The one input I cannot observe from data/ is whether the Bloodsong holder in this roster is melee or ranged. The observed multiplier is exactly the melee value (8%); had the holder been ranged the correct leaf would be 94.1 x 1.05 = 98.8 and the verdict would be both_wrong. Disfavored: Bloodsong is a support-quest item (shop tag SUPPORT, 400g, Classic SR 5v5 only) and the scenario pairs it with Black Cleaver (3000g FIGHTER item, 40 AD / 400 HP / 20 AH), a melee-bruiser shape; and the fitted multiplier lands on 8% to within rounding rather than on 5%. Independently, the same-direction Black Cleaver reading in step_2 would also make 101.7 the corrected value.
